actions: Reject any fault-injection value in the candidate Deployment.
analysis: A release that sets DEMO_ERROR_RATE to a non-zero value injects deliberate /work 500 responses and is a hard release risk.
cautions: Do not treat a recovered local drill as approval for shipping fault settings.
excerpt: - 500：`DEMO_ERROR_RATE=1`，真实请求日志返回 500；触发 DemoHighErrorRate，恢复为 200 后收到同指纹 resolved。
rollback: Restore DEMO_ERROR_RATE=0 and wait for a healthy rollout before considering the release again.
title: HTTP 500 故障注入
